blockers.description: The planned invalid-plugin-manifest fixture does not reach the ordinary per-plugin failure path. Dependency declaration discovery treats the unreadable zeta manifest as a scope-wide held verdict, so zeta and alpha both return skipped with dependents constrain.
blockers.workaround: Reconcile the intended continuation case with the deliberate D-10-05 fail-closed dependency contract before editing production. A failure injected after dependency preflight may test continuation without weakening dependency safety.

decisions.decision: Keep Tasks 1 and 2 as contract-test-only changes.
decisions.rationale: The focused behavioral tests and owner tests passed against the existing production implementation.

decisions.decision: Do not change production code for Task 3 until the dependency-safety conflict is understood.
decisions.rationale: The failing behavior is enforced by an existing fail-closed dependency rule, not by the marketplace loop stopping after an ordinary rejection.

next_action: Read the handoff and Plan 06-03, then reconcile Task 3's invalid-manifest fixture with D-10-05 before changing production or the scenario.
